original_question: Russell na-arụ ọrụ n'ụlọ ahịa na-ere anụ ụlọ na ekesakwa ahịhịa n'etiti ókè ndị ahụ. A na-edebe ókè ndị ahụ n'ịme ngiga atọ n'otú nhatanha ma a na-enye ókè ọbụla iberiibe ahịhịa isii. E nwere ngiga hamster iri a na-edosa iche ma a na-enye hamster ọbụla iberiibe ahịhịa ise. E nwekwara ụlọ oke oyibo ebe a na-ekesa iberiibe ahịhịa iri abụọ n'etiti ewi ndị ahụ. O nweghị ahịhịa e ji eme ịhe ebe ọzọ n'ụlọ ahịa ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ekesala iberiibe ahịhịa narị na iri isii n'etiti ókè obere, kedụ ókè ole nọ n'otu ngiga?
question_template: {name_male, Russell} na-arụ ọrụ n'ụlọ ahịa na-ere anụ ụlọ na ekesakwa ahịhịa n'etiti ókè ndị ahụ. A na-edebe ókè ndị ahụ n'ịme ngiga {num_digit_1, 3} n'otú nhatanha ma a na-enye ókè ọbụla iberiibe ahịhịa {num_digit_2, 6}. E nwere ngiga hamster {num_digit_3, 10} a na-edosa iche ma a na-enye hamster ọbụla iberiibe ahịhịa {num_digit_4, 5}. E nwekwara ụlọ oke oyibo ebe a na-ekesa iberiibe ahịhịa {num_digit_5, 20} n'etiti ewi ndị ahụ. O nweghị ahịhịa e ji eme ịhe ebe ọzọ n'ụlọ ahịa ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ekesala iberiibe ahịhịa {num_digit_6, 160} n'etiti ókè obere, kedụ ókè ole nọ n'otu ngiga?
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_6 - num_digit_3 * num_digit_4 - num_digit_5) / (num_digit_1 * num_digit_2)   # solve for rats per cage
